title: A clinical study of new treatments given with enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab in people with urothelial cancer (MK-3475-04D)
official: A Phase 1/2 Open-Label Rolling-Arm Umbrella Platform Study of Investigational Agents in Combination With Enfortumab Vedotin Plus Pembrolizumab as First-Line Treatment in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Carcinoma: KEYMAKER-U04–Substudy 04D
summary:
Main objective: 1.	To evaluate the safety and tolerability of an investigational agent in combination with EV plus pembrolizumab.
2.	To evaluate ORR per RECIST 1.1 by investigator assessment of an investigational agent in combination with EV plus pembrolizumab.

interventions.name: KEYTRUDA 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has histologically documented urothelial carcinoma (UC) that is locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic
2. Must provide a newly obtained or archival tumor tissue sample (core or excisional biopsy)
3. Must not have received prior systemic therapy for locally advanced or metastatic UC
4. If infected with Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), has well controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy
5. If positive for hepatitis B surface antigen, has received hepatitis B virus (HBV) antiviral therapy for at least 4 weeks and has undetectable HBV viral load before randomization
6. If participant has a history of hepatitis C virus (HCV), has undetectable HCV viral load before randomization
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has history of documented severe dry eye syndrome, severe Meibomian gland disease and/or blepharitis, or corneal disease that prevents/delays corneal healing
2. Has a history of (noninfectious) pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease that required steroids, or has current pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease
3. Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy
4. If infected with HIV, has a history of Kaposi’s sarcoma and/or Multicentric Castleman’s Disease
5. Has concurrent active HBV and HCV infection
6. Has a history of stem cell/solid organ transplant
7. Has active keratitis or corneal ulcerations
8. Has active inflammatory bowel disease requiring immunosuppressive medication, or previous history of inflammatory bowel disease (eg, Crohn’s disease, ulcerative colitis, or chronic diarrhea)
9. Has uncontrolled, significant cardiovascular disease or cerebrovascular disease within the 6 months preceding study intervention
10. Has a history of uncontrolled diabetes
11. Has pleural effusion, ascites, and/or pericardial effusion that are symptomatic or require repeated drainage
12. Has active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years
13. Has known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 2 years
14. Has known active central nervous system metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
